patch.role: Alternative path 1: incremental prepend of the closing colour tag at the colour step.
lines: if ndef['color'] and not ndef['underline'] and not end.startswith('[/color]'):

patch.role: Alternative path 2: rebuild the whole closing-tag sequence from ndef when the style entry is stored.

inputs.expose_color_underline: colour + underline token style (both repair paths are guarded off)
inputs.control_bold: bold-only style; A is not executed

rationale: Two disjoint singleton repairs reproduce A's effect on mask_color: U1 re-applies the prepend, U2 reconstructs the closing sequence from ndef at store time.  Undeclared combination (colour + underline) exposes the deletion.
